proposal.blind_spot: Current metrics show every kernel as uniformly DRAM-bound but cannot distinguish a kernel already at the memory roofline (rewrites only regress) from one with slack in grid parallelism or load-latency hiding (rewrites won up to 67x).

rationale.launch__waves_per_multiprocessor: HIGH (>=1) -> grid already saturates SMs, so cut bytes instead: fuse reduction intermediates into smem/registers, streaming-store hints, vectorize / LOW (<1) -> launch cannot saturate DRAM, restructure into more CTAs via smaller tiles or split-reduction (the fix behind the 67x/3.5x wins)
rationale.smsp__warp_issue_stalled_long_scoreboard: HIGH -> warps wait on global loads, add memory-level parallelism: more outstanding loads per thread, unroll/prefetch, raise occupancy / LOW -> DRAM wire is the true limit, only reduce byte volume and reject any rewrite that adds instructions (prevents the 0.044-0.55x regressions)
